title: DB test containers must run commands through the locked uv project env
answers: how do DB test containers get their python dependencies
why does the tests/db container ignore the image's pip packages
where should a new driver be installed for the database compose tests
body:
Invariant: Each tests/db service syncs its environment at startup with `uv sync --locked --no-default-groups --extra db --group db-test` into /opt/venv (UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT), using /usr/local/bin/python (UV_PYTHON), and runs the command with `exec uv run --no-sync "$@"`.
Enforced by: tests/db/entrypoint.sh (script-level), with the image-level installs removed from tests/db/Dockerfile and tests/db/Dockerfile.mssql.
What breaks if skipped: Omitting `--no-default-groups` pulls the full dev toolchain (including PySpark) into every container. Omitting `--locked` lets resolution drift from uv.lock. Using the mounted repo's `.venv` makes a local run overwrite the host's environment.
Constraints: INSTALL_MLFLOW_FROM_REPO no longer exists; every service installs the repo's mlflow as the project, so tests/db/compose.yml must not set it. Per-container sync is accepted because each sync takes seconds, and a shared cache volume would not survive `compose.sh` `down --volumes`.
applies: Services defined in tests/db/compose.yml and their entrypoint; not for host-side CI jobs outside the compose stack.
says: Running local database test containers overwrites the host machine virtual environment.
Database test containers download the full development toolchain instead of minimal test dependencies.
Containerized database testing environments pull unpinned packages rather than locked project dependencies.
Prevent database integration test containers from modifying the local repository environment.
search: Database test compose services must sync their environment at container startup into /opt/venv and execute commands through uv run --no-sync. Enforced by tests/db/entrypoint.sh, each service runs uv sync --locked --no-default-groups --extra db --group db-test using /usr/local/bin/python, replacing image-level package installations in tests/db/Dockerfile and tests/db/Dockerfile.mssql. This applies only to services in tests/db/compose.yml; it prevents host .venv overwrites, dependency drift from uv.lock, and loading dev tools like PySpark, while INSTALL_MLFLOW_FROM_REPO must not be set.
